note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1939: contests in five divisions. The members returned unopposed or deemed re-elected in the other 23 divisions are not named in the reports read. Returned unopposed. Printed "Ballymyre". L. Burke (Lab.) withdrew, leaving Shields elected (Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1939, p. 12).
